title: League table of one competition (optional asset kind 'standings:<competition_id>', capability 'standings')
description: The current table of one competition: season, one or more groups of rows (a single group with name null for a league table, the league phase included; named groups for cups), whether the table is complete, and where and when it was read. Readers show it only while the manifest carries rights.standings with enabled true, treat table_complete false as a partial table, and ignore a table older than rights.standings.max_age_days. No fixtures, scores or programme data.

competition_id.description: SportsLiveInfo taxonomy competition id, the same id as events' competition_id (for example football.premier_league)

season_start.description: YYYY-MM-DD, when the source states it

season_end.description: YYYY-MM-DD, when the source states it

matchday.description: Current matchday, when the source states it

name.description: null for a single league table; the group name (Group A) for cup groups

stage.description: Source stage such as REGULAR_SEASON or LEAGUE_STAGE, when stated

participant.description: Team name as the source writes it (football-data.org: Arsenal FC); match to events by normalised name

participant_id.description: fd:<football-data.org team id> or as:<API-Sports team id>; events do not carry ids yet

form.description: Optional, oldest to newest, letters W D L (at most 10)

expected_teams.description: Rows a complete table of this competition has

table_complete.description: teams == expected_teams, positions 1..n in every group, no dropped row
